hedges.reason: E46 is the only candidate that tracks whether US envoy diplomacy on Russia-Ukraine turns into a leader-level result, which is the driver in my hedge thesis. The Gulf leg is also the one that overlaps most with the Israel-Syria failure path. Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar host both the Witkoff/Kushner-run Russia-Ukraine channel and the Abraham Accords and Syria-reconstruction diplomacy. A world where Trump is closing deals with Gulf states as hosts is where both a Trump-Putin Gulf summit and a showcase Israel-Syria signing become more likely. The other Russia-Ukraine instruments (E24 and E68 on Russian captures, E20 on the Duma) measure battlefield or domestic outcomes rather than whether the US deal-making effort works, so they don't express the thesis.
